method:
Capture the original selected-stream AudioFiles identity accessor offline.

Original source virtual+0x28 (0x10129a720) and its original field-4 getter
(0x101d0715c) execute unchanged. The original URI parser creates the separate
requested source URI; generated AudioFiles construction and explicit synthetic
protobuf string storage supply inputs. No key request, transport, account or
profile is used. This proves the streaming source's raw identity, not which
encryption/license transport consumes it.
substitutedInputs: Synthetic source object with original source vtable and original-parser URI.
Original generated AudioFiles constructor with explicit standard protobuf ArenaStringPtr storage.
Standard memory/allocation/string providers inherited from the native query oracle.
limits: Only raw streaming-source identity access is proved; no original AP or HTTP key/license owner executes.
Requested URI and source audio identity are distinct; equality is not checked by this accessor.
A missing response or audio_id length other than16 returns null; there is no URI fallback here.
